mentions.name: New Tab Widgets
mentions.description: A browser start page (new tab page) for power users and workers in tech, built around widgets. Its iframe widget lets users select any element on a website and turn it into a widget on their start page.
mentions.audience: power users and workers in tech
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on creating the most useful browser start page for power users and workers in tech.

https://newtabwidgets.com.

One of my favourite features is the iframe widget, which allows you to select any element on a website and turn it in to a widget.
